title: CodeChef: Burgers
description: Chef is making burgers. Each burger requires 1 patty and 1 bun. Given `a` patties and `b` buns, determine maximum number of complete burgers Chef can make.
starter_code:
def max_burgers(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def max_burgers(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return min(a, b)
explanation: Minimum of available components dictates burger count in O(1) time.
